_what: THE ARTICULATION DEAL (PLAN 1d, 2026-11-10; RUNNING_LOG §145) — his chosen articulations for the counterpoint section (SW-35), per lane, as the deck tools/artic_deal.js deals from. Edit the lists, not the tool. A deck entry is a recipe technique key of the lane's instrument; an entry with `lane` moves the note to that lane (the percussionist's unpitched strikes dealt among the glockenspiel's notes: 'we can keep the glockenspiel, just mix those in'). `long` names the articulations that want a LONGER note (his word: 'grow longer notes for flz / bow pressure'): a note shorter than longMinS is grown toward it within the lane's room, or dealt another articulation when there is no room.
_notes: The percussion entries: his 'scrape china · brake drum · spring coil · bass drum · the rim' — the bass drum is the Gran Cassa (C) cloned at §144 (medium felt as the plain hit; 'rute on rim' as the rim — the Alt has no rim in its catalog entry). The piano's `plucked` plays only once his Kontakt hand step (PLAN 1c step 4) is done. The cello has no notes in the section as saved; its deck waits.
